data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2023 ended on January 29, 2023. For that year the company reported revenue of $26.97 billion, essentially flat compared with $26.91 billion in fiscal 2022, which works out to growth of about 0.2%. GAAP net income for fiscal 2023 was $4.37 billion, down roughly 55% from $9.75 billion in fiscal 2022. Diluted earnings per share fell from $3.85 to $1.74 on the pre-split basis. The drop in profit came mainly from a sharp decline in Gaming revenue, which fell 27%. Other causes were inventory charges of about $2.17 billion and a $1.35 billion charge for the terminated Arm acquisition. A 41% rise in Data Center revenue to about $15.0 billion largely offset the Gaming weakness on the top line.
